SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, c.chunk_order AS chunkOrder, c.location, c.content, c.tags, d.title, d.source_citation AS citation, d.source_url AS sourceUrl, d.version, d.review_status AS reviewStatus, d.scope, d.category, d.source_version AS sourceVersion, d.verification_status AS verificationStatus, d.license_note AS licenseNote, d.publisher, d.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, d.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, u.user_id AS reviewerUserId, u.role AS reviewerRole FROM knowledge_chunks c JOIN knowledge_documents d ON d.document_id = c.document_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = d.reviewed_by WHERE d.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND d.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' AND d.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND (d.category IS NULL OR d.category <> 'TEACHER_EXAMPLE' OR u.role = 'TEACHER')
AND d.review_status IN #{status}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY c.document_id, c.chunk_order
